statement: SDL PS5 HIDAPI handles basic and enhanced USB/BT state, including six axes, button masks, dual touch contacts, gyroscope, accelerometer, sensor timestamps and battery state. Enhanced reporting and SDL sensor registration depend on mode/hints and device classification.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, HHD adbd50f, virtualgamepad archive a5310c6; physical firmware/revision not measured
applicability.scope: SDL_hidapi_ps5.c 90-138, 399-445, 802-855, 1355-1405. No independent Steam acceptance implied.
